notes.title: Next Game Announcement and com__et 60% off in Steam Visual Novel Fest!
notes.notes:
com__et and the soundtrack are both 60% off in the Visual Novel fest, feel free to tell your friends and VN fans while it's got the biggest discount yet.

And also announcing our next game - [b]Ravel the Frays[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44643657/e16797b6f1acf47df5bbd130597ebf492d7d88eb.png[/img]

A sci fi mystery visual novel that also has a dialogue based puzzle mechanic. It's longer than com__et so we'll be working on it a while, but go follow the Steam page if you want to keep up with news, as we'll soon have a trailer and then a public demo you can try out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499260/Ravel_the_Frays/

notes.title: Happy Anniversary com__et 🎂 ! Now in French and Spanish
notes.notes:
Happy birthday to com__et, which released nearly a full year ago now! 

Thank you to everyone who's played, reviewed and shared it with friends. Me and Marija enjoy every kind word, and we're working on something new under the name "Margarita Games". We'll have something to show publicly for that soon, but you can follow [url="https://buttondown.com/SuperBiasedGary"]my newsletter[/url] for news in the meantime.

com__et is also in French and Spanish, thanks to these folks for their translation work:

Spanish: [url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/katya-simonyan-kaizer]Katya Simonyan Kaizer[/url]

French: [url="https://twitter.com/TrefleV"]Tereza Vag (treflev)[/url]
with support from:
Astride Couillaux
Ha-Thanh Gore-Koenig (MadameEtrange)
Ludovic Seigneurin (Localicows)

That's all for now,
-Gary

notes.title: com__et available now localised to Simplified Chinese - __流星
notes.notes:
com__et / __流星 - romance/horror visual novel now available in Simplified Chinese.
Thanks to Hannah Lu and Michael Stein of Warlocs for their hard work.

A queer romance\horror visual novel about being locked into a path, and having _______ words hidden from You. Find Your way to discover what's missing and reach Your ____ End.

《____流星》简体中文版现已上线！
感谢Warlocs的Hannah Lu、Michael Stein为本游戏的本地化做出的努力。

这是一部集浪漫和恐怖元素于一身的酷儿主题视觉小说，描述了一个外界压力下被迫做出选择的故事，里面包含很多被隐去的____文字。进入游戏，探索那些隐藏在屏幕之下的文字，解锁____结局。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44643657/433cef6f086846542db64daf81436239d3ec413a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: com__et is on sale in The Storyteller's Festival
notes.notes:
The Storyteller's Festival is a Steam celebration of the art of storytelling, featuring a range of story focused games including com__et. They're on sale starting now, so check it out for some new games to pick up, and make sure to review ones you have played and tell your friends about any you recommend!
